snippet.title: Somebody's Home: The Boarding House | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5233740/Somebodys_Home_The_Boarding_House/

Somebody's Home is a horror series based on real cases. Every episode tells one of them: ordinary people, ordinary places, and something that should not have been there.

This is the first case.

1980. You rent a room in a boarding house on a quiet street. Dinner is at eight, sharp, and Theodora, the old woman who runs it, tells you that here you are not a guest. You are family. She tends the garden herself, and asks only one thing: that you never set foot in it without telling her first.
